normalization_plan.reason: count_wlMint is a parameter used only to bound the wlMint loop and payment check.
proof_wlMint is a parameter consumed only by merkle verification in wlMint.
count_batchMint is a parameter used only to bound the batchMint loop and payment check.
_merkleRoot parameter merges directly into the setMerkleRoot state write.
owner_isApprovedForAll parameter is used only for the proxy lookup in isApprovedForAll.
operator_isApprovedForAll parameter is used only for the proxy comparison in isApprovedForAll.
newImplementation parameter flows only into the _authorizeUpgrade hook.
tokenId_tokenURI parameter indexes token URI storage in tokenURI.
interfaceId parameter is compared only in supportsInterface.
from_beforeTokenTransfer parameter selects enumeration branch in the transfer hook.
to_beforeTokenTransfer parameter selects enumeration branch in the transfer hook.
tokenId_beforeTokenTransfer parameter indexes enumeration mappings in the transfer hook.
tokenId_burn parameter is destroyed by the _burn override.
tokenId_wlMint loop-local merges into the wlMint minting logic.
tokenId_batchMint loop-local merges into the batchMint minting logic.
